comment: The pnpm and Bun lines Proscenium supports (#154). The source of truth: the CLI checks manager versions against it, and CI pins the versions it lists. `ci` is the exact version CI runs; `eol` is when the line's owner stops maintaining it. pnpm 10 is not supported (decided 4 October 2026): it leaves a context on an older copy of a shared peer after the app upgrades it, and 11 and 12 do not.
